project.title: Ví dụ liền mạch – 4 cảnh (mẫu để AI bắt chước, không phải bài hát thật)
project.visual_style: photorealistic cinematic live-action family-friendly children's music video
project.style_anchor: Shot on a cinematic 35mm lens look with shallow depth of field, soft warm color grade with gentle teal shadows, subtle fine film grain, soft natural contrast, clean highlights, no HDR glow. The entire music video shares this exact same photographic look in every clip.
project.light_direction_anchor: The main key light always comes from screen-left and slightly above, so shadows fall gently toward screen-right in every clip of the whole video. Only the color temperature and brightness of the light may change between chapters, never its direction.
project.palette_anchor: Color palette for the whole video: sky blue, warm sand beige, soft white, with tomato red as the single accent. Every location, costume and prop stays inside this palette.
project.camera_height_anchor: Camera stays at child eye level, about 1 meter above the ground, unless the camera move explicitly says low angle or high angle.
project.screen_direction: Story travel direction is left-to-right. The character faces or moves toward screen-right whenever traveling. Never cross the 180-degree line relative to the main character; never mirror the layout.

global_restrictions: Mỗi cảnh là một video liên tục đúng 8 giây (Veo 3.1).
Chỉ các nhân vật được tag mới xuất hiện; không thêm người/động vật khác.
Không lật gương bối cảnh hoặc đổi vị trí trái/phải.
important_instructions: Generate every scene in landscape 16:9 widescreen.
Only tag ingredients that belong to the scene's chapter plus global ingredients.
Do not generate dialogue. The final Suno audio track will be added during editing.

format_lock: Create one continuous 8-second video in 16:9 landscape format. Photorealistic cinematic live-action family-friendly children's music video: realistic fabrics and lighting, natural gentle movement, soft cinematic depth of field, bright clean colors. Use one camera angle or one smooth camera movement only. No abrupt cuts, montage or internal scene transition. Keep the final two seconds visually stable. Do not generate text in the image. No subtitles, captions, dialogue, speech, logo or watermark.
